headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of September 15, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming SPY, with an average return of 23.19% compared to SPY's 11.72%. This results in an average alpha of 11.47%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a substantial return of 48.80%, contributing significantly to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 6.31%, highlighting a notable disparity within the portfolio set. This outperformance against SPY serves as a useful signal during periods of market stress or uncertainty. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
